globalConfigHelpDesc: These values are used as defaults on the Code Generator page. You can override them during generation without changing the saved defaults.
defaultTimezoneHelp: Used for time display such as generation history. Asia/Shanghai is recommended for users in China.
authorHelp: Author name used in generated code comments, for example: admin, Alice.
basePackageHelp: Java package root path used for backend template output, for example: com.company.project
basePackageInvalid: Invalid package format, for example: com.example.demo
moduleNameHelp: Business module name used in API paths and some output paths, for example: system, user-center
moduleNameInvalid: Module name can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and must start with a letter
tablePrefixHelp: Used to strip a unified table prefix. Example: sys_user -> User when prefix is sys_. Leave empty to keep prefix.
tablePrefixInvalid: Prefix can only contain letters, numbers, underscores, or be empty
defaultTemplateGroupHelp: The default selected template group for code generation. You can check IDs in Templates.
